verdict.rationale: Zoom's AI Services auth docs describe creating API credentials with selectable permission scopes, an expiration option, and an IP allowlist. Short-lived JWTs are also documented for client-to-backend calls, so least-privilege credentials for an agent are a first-party capability. Missing for 10: documentation of the available scope list and how fine-grained it is, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
